Occult Association (Bad Eden): Alchemist.

“Reality is a solvent. I’m the one shaking the bottle.”

Alchemists do not seek purity. They seek conversion.

Where others pursue the Great Work through revelation, alignment, or doctrine, the Alchemist treats it as a throughput problem. Matter, belief, institutions, and people are all half-finished reactions waiting for the right catalyst.

An Alchemist does not ask what should this be? They ask what can I turn this into before it detonates?

They stabilize supply chains with miracles, turn contamination into leverage, and force abundance out of systems that should already have collapsed. Nothing they do is free. Every refinement leaves residue.

How Alchemists pursue the Great Work:

  • By converting one form of value into another
  • By stabilizing volatile systems just long enough to matter
  • By treating Sparks, OPs, and infrastructure as reactive states
  • By accepting that every solution leaves chemical, moral, or metaphysical residue

Resonance: Yesod — foundation, transfer, containment, and the unstable bridge between idea and matter.

Tell-tales: antiseptic, ozone, burnt sugar, stained gloves, reinforced glass where glass should not survive.

Faction Effect (Passive):

  • +1 to Economy OP rolls (especially production, infrastructure, and supply stabilization)

Cost Principle: Alchemical victories leave residue. Expect shortages, contamination, attention, moral debt, or unstable downstream consequences when you push too hard.
